author: Felizia
label: croc2
prompt:
ACTION: the dapper crocodile gentleman from image 1 squeezes through an open safe-deposit hatch and climbs up, emerging to stand proudly on top of a small mound of stacked gold bars, cane in one hand, a tiny golden ladder leaning against the mound.
SHOT: low wide angle looking up at him on the gold mound, 35mm lens, slow push in of a few centimetres.
PLACE: inside a vast treasure chamber, a mound of gleaming stacked gold bars, a little golden ladder leaning on it, warm golden reflections all around.
LIGHT: one warm golden key from above, about 3:1, shiny highlights on the gold.
SOUND: webbed waddling and scrabbling, then a short glorious angelic choir singing a bright "aaah" the moment he steps onto the gold; no spoken words.

lint.msg: bright: says nothing executable. Name the lens, the distance, one light source and its direction.
